tagline: The chiptune song lives in the GIF. Invite, and you jam the same track.
description:
Close it, come back — the same notes are still on the grid. The song is saved inside this file, so handing someone the GIF hands them the song.

BeepBox itself: click the grey rows to drop notes, drag to change length, stack them for chords. Patterns along the bottom are the bars of the song; the purple loop is what repeats. Chip, FM, noise, supersaw — the original tracker, offline, with no URL to copy and no account.

On a phone, pinch or tap + / − to zoom the grid, then pan. Press Invite in the bar above and a friend lands on this same song; either of you can change it, you both hear it.

An unofficial port of BeepBox by John Nesky. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
